The '''Uln''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bird/Legends|bird]]. It could be served as [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. [[Feyodor]] of [[Feyodor's Tavern]] served stuffed Uln bird glazed in a light mist of [[Zsajhira berry juice]].<ref name="II" />
